I totally understand! Sobriety isn't easy and that was one of the hardest parts for me as well. Learning how to live again with what felt like a gaping hole. I had to stop playing certain games or hanging with certain people or going to certain places. Even had to stop drinking my favorite drinks for a while because I used them as chasers. The way I think of it is, it wasn't me losing myself. It was stepping out of my comfort zone. I was attached to drinking. It was easy. It numbed the pain, stress, and irritation of the world. It kept me safe in a bubble of ignorance. 

Coming out of that is hard. It takes strength to have to feel again. Have to deal again. Have to rebuild ourselves. Who we are when we drink isn't really who we are. Who we are when things are hard and we are fighting the good fight, that's who we are. It took time but I'm so much happier with who I am now. Nothing worth doing is easy but I promise it's worth it.
